name: The Sterile Promise
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: encyclopedia cover illustration for Avarenne, a mature late-industrial occult fantasy novel. Scene: Experimental seed trays in an arid agricultural station, one tray of healthy young sprouts beside another of visibly ungerminated seeds, separated cloth seed bags and irrigation channel, late industrial fantasy, no monster plants or apocalyptic dead landscape. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, tactile architecture and believable materials, dramatic but readable light, atmospheric depth. One coherent scene, landscape 3:2. Show only the specified bounded manifestation; supernatural graphic traces are illustrative, never game interface. Anonymous adult figures only when specified, no named canonical character. No legible text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, card frame or collage. No additional creature, portal, deity, avatar or city-wide catastrophe. Avoid exaggerating the effect beyond its local source.
visual_caption: Germinazione e tratto selezionato sono due proprietà da verificare separatamente. Ricostruzione illustrativa, non prova diagnostica o fonte di nuove capacità.
visual_review: APPROVATA: scena, limiti illustrativi e assenza di poteri aggiuntivi verificati
